newsitem.title: USA: NEBRASKA FED CATTLE MARKET AT STANDSTILL - PRIVATE.
newsitem.headline: NEBRASKA FED CATTLE MARKET AT STANDSTILL - PRIVATE.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle trade near midday Friday was at a standstill, market sources said.
Packer bids were light at $104.00 to $105.00 per cwt on a dressed basis following thin sales at $105.00 on Thursday. Cattle owners were asking mostly $106.00.
Sales this week were light, with many feedlots expected to carry cattle over to next week's showlists.
The large cattle supplies could keep prices under pressure, some sources noted.
Weekly sales in Nebraska was estimated near 52,000 head. Showlist estimates ranged from 78,000 to 84,000 head.
